title: Senior backend Java developer - CLM
jobDescription:
Job Summary
We're looking for a Senior Java Developer to design, build, and scale backend services for a high throughput, low latency platform with strict reliability and auditability requirements. You'll own end to end delivery from design to production collaborating closely with Product, QA, and DevOps.
Responsibilities
  • Design and implement microservices and event-driven components in Java (preferably Java 17).
  • Model and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and transactions for performance and integrity.
  • Build resilient, observable services on AWS (ECS/EKS/Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, MSK/Kinesis, IAM).
  • Ship with strong CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions) and leverage GitHub Copilot to accelerate high quality delivery.
  • Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance (circuit breakers, retries, idempotency, backpressure).
  • Implement security and compliance controls (authz/authn, secrets, IAM policies, encryption at rest/in transit).
  • Own production operations: monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards.
Skills
Must have
  • 7+ years of professional backend experience with Java (Core Java, Collections/Concurrency, Streams, JVM internals).
  • Strong with Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security; understanding of Spring Cloud is a plus).
  • 5+ years of professional experience with Angular
  • Exposure to Python for tooling and automation.
  • Proven expertise with PostgreSQL: indexing strategies, query tuning (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE), transactions/locking, isolation levels.
  • Hands on AWS experience: deploying and operating production services (at least 3 of ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, SQS/SNS/MSK/Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Solid API design (REST/gRPC), versioning, pagination, and backward compatibility.
  • Production grade observability (logs, metrics, tracing; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar).
  • CI/CD with GitHub and GitHub Actions (branching strategies, code reviews, trunk based or GitFlow).
  • Practical use of GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistants) to boost productivity while maintaining code quality.
  • Experience building fault tolerant distributed systems (circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting; resilience patterns).
  • Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation at least one).
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulns (OWASP Top 10).
  • Excellent communication; ability to turn ambiguous requirements into actionable technical plans.
Nice to have
  • Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics.
  • Event streaming messaging: Kafka, MSK, Kinesis, RabbitMQ.
  • Data modeling for auditable workflows, SLAs, and multi party approval processes.
  • Experience with multi tenant architectures and row level security.
  • Knowledge of domain-driven design (DDD) and CQRS patterns.
  • Experience with performance profiling (JFR, async-profiler) and JVM tuning (GC, heap, thread pools).
  • Exposure to Python and Node.js for tooling and automation.
  • Familiarity with feature flags (e.g., LaunchDarkly) and blue/green or canary deployments.
  • Compliance/controls mindset (audit trails, data lineage, segregation of duties).

title: SeniorFPGA Developer
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.
Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.
Responsibilities
  • We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer a recognized technical authority to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test Measurement products.
  • The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools.
  • This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.
Skills Must have
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps SerDes/transceiver-based FPGA designs.
  • Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and/or VHDL required.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.
Nice to have
  • Patents or published work in FPGA architecture, high-speed digital design, or DSP.
  • Experience defining test strategies for multi-Gbps compliance testing (particularly relevant for TM product development).
  • General purpose microprocessor and DSP systems, PCIe, high-speed digital board design, PLL design, and analog signal conditioning experience.
  • Simulation experience using Siemens Questa, Aldec Riviera, or similar tools.
  • Contribution to or deep familiarity with open verification methodologies (e.g., cocotb, UVM community contributions).
  • Utilization of generative AI tools to assist in concept and implementation of FPGA designs.

title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

About Varaha

Varaha is the largest carbon removal developer in Asia, working with more than 200,000 smallholder farmers. Trusted by brands like Google and Microsoft, we combine an exceptional team with deeply impactful work. Through regenerative agriculture, afforestation, and biochar, our projects remove carbon while simultaneously restoring soils, protecting biodiversity, and improving livelihoods far beyond our project boundaries. We are a profitable, rapidly growing company backed by premier global private equity and top-tier venture capital. Our roots are in India, and our impact is global.

The Opportunity

Varaha runs the largest smallholder soil carbon project in the world and has closed the largest regenerative agriculture deals in the market. Behind that sits a measurement stack built on multiple bio-geo-chemical models, remote sensing, and machine learning, calibrated against physical soil samples from the field by a world-class science team. Buyers, auditors, and funders all want the same thing from it: a clear, sourced account of what we measured and why it holds.

You are the commercial teams technical authority on regenerative agriculture and afforestation, and the person who turns several hundred thousand hectares of fieldwork into documents a Chief Sustainability Officer can act on. Regenerative agriculture comes first. Afforestation and reforestation follow.

We are deliberately open on background. Agronomists from agri-conglomerates, people who have run contract farming or sustainable sourcing programmes at scale, agri-input and agri-tech technical leads, remote sensing specialists, and programme leads who have delivered smallholder work across large geographies all fit. What matters is that you have stood in a field, know what the data from it can and cannot support, and write clearly.

Reporting To: CCO

  • Answer buyer and auditor diligence. Sort what you can answer now from what needs expert input, then produce the response with sources, assumptions, and the limits of the claim stated.

  • Sit in on sales calls. You explain the measurement, the project, and the impact directly to the client. The project team stays on the projects.

  • Run our side of ratings and verification. Prepare submissions, handle analyst and auditor questions, and push back with evidence where a finding is wrong.

  • Build the answer library so the same question is never answered from scratch twice and our language stays consistent across proposals, contracts, and project documents.

  • Create what is missing. Method summaries, appendices, diagrams, data summaries, and operating procedures, wherever a gap is holding up a deal.

  • Turn data into claims. Read agronomy datasets and remote sensing outputs and convert them into short statements we can defend in front of a buyer.

  • Cover the impact side. Farmer and community outcomes weigh as heavily with buyers as the carbon itself. You build the evidence base on incomes, livelihoods, and co-benefits across 200,000+ smallholders, work with what the field data supports when it is limited, and state where it is thin.

  • Guide the commercial team on presenting technical content accurately, and train them to handle the straightforward questions themselves.

Qualifications

  • 4-10 years working on agriculture, agroforestry, or land use, ideally involving smallholder farmers in Asia or Africa.

  • Technical writing that has survived outside scrutiny. Project documents, monitoring reports, diligence responses, or funding proposals. Please send samples.

  • A working grasp of the fundamentals that decide whether a carbon project is credible: baselines, additionality, permanence, leakage, and buffer pools. If you know these from an adjacent field, say so and we will look at it.

  • Comfort with soil carbon or biomass measurement, sampling design, and the monitoring that sits around it.

  • Ability to work with agronomy data and remote sensing outputs directly.

Nature-based carbon has a credibility problem across the industry, and much of it comes down to how the work is explained. Varahas measurement is among the strongest in the sector. Making that legible to buyers and funders moves capital toward 200,000 smallholder land stewards who are already doing the work.

Embark on an exciting journey into the realm of Agile delivery with 3Pillar! We are looking for a dedicated, pure-play Scrum Master to join our team on the Week strategic platform engagement.

At 3Pillar, we don't just write code; we craft cutting-edge technologies that revolutionize industries. The Scrum Master role is deliberately broad, spanning delivery, coaching, and teaching. You will not be "the person who removes blockers," but a facilitator of agility and a mentor for self-managing teams. If you are driven by a passion for building high-maturity, self-sufficient teams and are ready to make a real-world impact, consider this your pass to the captivating world of Product Development at 3Pillar!

Key Responsibilities

  • Coach Facilitate: Guide the team on Scrum and the Agile Manifesto; facilitate core ceremonies (stand-ups, planning, reviews, retrospectives) in a hands-off style asking questions and facilitating rather than directing or doing the work.

  • Empower Enable: Build self-managing teams, creating a safe environment that allows teams to fail and improve, driving toward self-sufficiency within a few months.

  • Partner with Product: Work in a co-empowering relationship with the Product Owner, coaching them on agile boundaries, backlog ordering, and creating value.

  • Metrics Improvement: Own agile metrics to surface insights that drive continuous improvement; use data evidence to push back constructively on unrealistic delivery dates and protect team flow.

  • Stakeholder Management: Manage stakeholders under executive scrutiny, operating confidently within defined escalation pathways to ensure concerns are heard at the right level.

  • Continuous Improvement: Stay with teams for the long term, driving sustained focus on maturity and supporting other Scrum Masters across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Agile Expertise: Strong command of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto; practitioners must be operating at or close to an agile-coach level (not early-career).

  • Pure Scrum Master Role: This is a non-hybrid role; we are looking for dedicated Scrum Masters, not combined roles (e.g., SM/Business Analyst).

  • Coaching Influence: Proven experience in coaching and facilitating without authority; comfortable letting teams find their own pace.

  • Metrics Analysis: In-depth knowledge of agile metrics; ability to interpret data to drive improvement and protect team flow.

  • Scaling Experience: Fluency in scaling options (e.g., scrum-of-scrums) and the judgement to apply them proportionately as the estate grows.

  • Stakeholder Management: Confidence in managing stakeholders under scrutiny and escalating concerns effectively.

Additional Experience Desired

  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience in designing and running workshops, mindset exercises, and games for new and existing teams.

  • Emotional Intelligence: Ability to read team health through behavior, tone, and human interaction.

  • Missionary Mindset: Demonstrable track record of helping teams move from "cost-centre" mindsets to high-performing, mission-driven teams.

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

title: Computational Biology Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Role Summary
The AIN-based Computational Biology Data Scientist will design, implement, and advance advanced analytical and AI-driven frameworks to enable translational and reverse-translational insights from clinical trial data across Amgens global development portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of computational biology, advanced statistics, and modern machine learning, with a strong emphasis on predictive and prognostic biomarker modeling, multi-omic data integration, and next-generation AI-enabled analytical platforms.
The successful candidate will contribute intellectually and technically to Amgens precision medicine strategy by developing rigorous, scalable, and scientifically interpretable models that link molecular, cellular, and clinical phenotypes to disease stratification, efficacy, safety, and adverse event outcomes. This role requires demonstrated depthnot familiarityin applied modeling, multi-omic analytics, and AI systems, with evidence of impact through peer-reviewed publications, production-grade codebases, or verifiable industry experience.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Modeling Translational Analytics
  • Design and implement predictive and prognostic biomarker models using clinical trial and biomarker data, including response, resistance, disease stratification, and adverse event endpoints.
  • Develop and apply multi-omic integration frameworks (e.g., factor models, MOFA-style latent variable approaches, matrix factorization, graph-based methods) to jointly analyze genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, imaging, and clinical covariates.
  • Apply advanced statistical methodologies relevant to clinical development, including longitudinal and mixed-effects models, survival analysis, missing data and imputation strategies, confounder adjustment, and model interpretability.
  • Contribute to study-level and cross-program analyses that inform mechanism of action, patient selection strategies, and development decisions.
Machine Learning, AI Emerging Capabilities
  • Build and evaluate machine learning, deep learning and causal inference models applied to biological and clinical data, with a clear understanding of model assumptions, limitations, and validation in regulated environments.
  • Develop or meaningfully contribute to AI-enabled analytical systems, including:
    • Foundation and large language modelbased approaches (e.g., GPT-class models) for scientific workflows
    • Generative models for representation learning, hypothesis generation, or simulation
    • Agentic AI systems (assistive, conversational, automated, predictive, or sentinel) to support analysis, decision-making, or platform capabilities
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure analytical methods are reproducible, scalable, and production-ready.
Scientific Rigor, Collaboration Communication
  • Translate biological and clinical questions into well-defined analytical strategies and clearly articulate modeling choices, assumptions, and uncertainties.
  • Collaborate closely with biomarker scientists, clinicians, biostatisticians, and data engineers across global teams and time zones.
  • Communicate complex analytical results and their implications effectively through technical documentation, presentations, and cross-functional forums.
  • Operate with scientific independence while proactively seeking alignment and clarification in a highly matrixed, global development environment.
Basic Qualifications
  • Doctorate degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline with 12 years of relevant experience
    OR
  • Masters degree in a quantitative discipline with 5 years of relevant experience
  • 6+ years of experience in an industry setting
Preferred Qualifications
Candidates should provide verifiable evidence for most of the following:
Quantitative Computational Depth
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience developing statistical or machine learning models for complex, multi-modal biomedical or clinical datasets, evidenced by:
    • Peer-reviewed publications in reputable journals, and/or
    • Public or internal GitHub repositories with substantive analytical or modeling contributions, and/or
    • Clearly documented industry experience supporting clinical or translational programs.
  • Proven expertise in Python and R for scientific computing and modeling, including the development of reusable, well-documented analytical code.
  • Experience with modern ML/DL libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, tidymodels), with an understanding of when such methods are appropriate given clinical context.
Translational Clinical Relevance
  • Demonstrated understanding of drug development and clinical trial data, including biomarker strategies, endpoint definitions, and translational study design.
  • Experience working with real-world clinical or biomarker data, including data QC, preprocessing, feature engineering, integration, modeling, and interpretation.
  • Familiarity with common clinical biomarker modalities and data types (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging, immunoassays).
AI, Innovation Platform Mindset
  • Direct experience applying or extending generative AI, foundation models, or agentic systems for scientific, analytical, or decision-support use cases.
  • Ability to critically evaluate new methods and technologies and assess their suitability for regulated, high-impact biomedical applications.
Professional Global Operating Skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative work to diverse audiences.
  • Experience working with global teams and stakeholders across time zones; willingness to operate flexibly to support global programs.
  • Demonstrated intellectual humility, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to pivot analytical approaches as program needs evolve.
  • Strong sense of ownership, scientific judgment, and accountability in complex, interdisciplinary projects.
What Will Distinguish Top Candidates
  • Clear evidence of end-to-end ownership of analytical work that influenced scientific or development decisions.
  • Depth in framework-building, not just model application.
  • A demonstrated ability to balance methodological sophistication with biological and clinical relevance.
  • Prior experience in large, global biotech or pharmaceutical organizations is strongly preferred.

What you do at AMD changes everything. At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives.

The Person

  • A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks.
  • Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs.
  • Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness.
  • Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation.
  • Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs.
  • Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams.
  • Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks.
  • Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams.
  • Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings.
  • Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria.
  • Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners.
  • Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas.
  • Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements.
  • Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity.
  • Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones.

Preferred Experience

  • 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
  • Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products.
  • Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria.
  • Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments.
  • Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency.
  • Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning.
  • Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
  • Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
  • Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

Academic Credentials

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
  • Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience migrating Teams associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS 102) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises .
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Job Title: AI Model Quality Engineer Healthcare (Wellness & Digital Health)

Location: Bangalore

Experience

6 - 12+ years overall experience

3+ years in ML / AI model testing, validation, or governance

Role Overview

We are seeking an AI Model Quality Engineer to ensure trustworthiness, safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance of AI/ML models used in our platform. This role sits at the intersection of Quality Engineering, Data Science, Responsible AI, and Healthcare Compliance. You will serve as the independent validation authority within the Model Development Life Cycle (MDLC). Functioning as a strategic partner to but distinct from the Model Development team, you will ensure strict separation of concerns by owning the objective validation gates between "ML Model Testing" and "Clinical Handoff". You will be responsible for certifying that models meet all defined acceptance criteria before they are exposed to clinical evaluators or production traffic.

Key Responsibilities

1. Model Quality, Validation, & "Shift Left" Strategy

  • Requirements Definition: Partner with Clinical and Product teams during the Requirement Gathering phase to translate clinical goals into quantifiable technical acceptance criteria (e.g., defining specific thresholds for False Negatives, bias limits, or hallucination rates).
  • Golden Set Management: Create, maintain, and secure "Golden Datasets" and "Adversarial Test Sets" that are isolated from the training process, ensuring true out-of-sample validation.
  • Test Execution: Design and execute test strategies for AI/ML models (predictive, classification, recommendation, and GenAI/LLM-based systems).
  • Comprehensive Validation: Validate model behavior across accuracy, bias, robustness, stability, and safety using independent test pipelines.

2. Engineering & Clinical Handoffs

  • API Contract Validation: Validate model artifacts (containers, APIs) during the Non-production Model Deploy phase to ensure latency, throughput, and error handling meet Engineering Service Level Agreements (SLAs) before handoff.
  • Clinical Pre-Screening: Execute automated "Red Teaming" and safety checks (e.g., PII leakage, hallucination triggers) to sanitize models before they enter the Clinical Testing phase, maximizing the efficiency of Clinical SME time.
  • Release Gating: Own the final "Go/No-Go" decision for model promotion based on pre-defined quality gates.

3. Drift Detection, Monitoring & Feedback Loops

  • Automated Feedback Loops: Design and implement automated pipelines that trigger "Retraining Feedback Loops" when post-deployment monitoring detects drift or performance degradation.
  • Drift Mechanisms: Design and test data drift, concept drift, and prediction drift detection mechanisms.
  • Data Sanity Checks: Implement upstream validation to catch data quality issues (missing values, schema changes) before model training begins.
  • Alerting: Define thresholds, alerts, and runbooks for drift remediation and rollback strategies.

4. Explainability & Transparency

  • Validate model explainability using tools such as SHAP, LIME, Integrated Gradients, or equivalent.
  • Ensure explanations are clinically meaningful, auditable, and regulator-ready.
  • Partner with Data Science teams to define explainability acceptance criteria.

5. Hallucination & GenAI Safety (if LLMs are used)

  • Design test scenarios to detect hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and medical misinformation.
  • Validate grounding mechanisms (RAG, citations, confidence scoring).
  • Ensure models do not generate diagnostic or treatment advice beyond approved scope.

6. Healthcare Compliance & Responsible AI

  • Ensure AI systems align with HIPAA (PHI protection), FDA SaMD principles, and Responsible AI guidelines.
  • Participate in model risk reviews, audits, and governance forums.
  • Maintain documentation for model cards, data sheets, and audit artifacts.

Required Qualifications

Core Skills

  • Strong background in Quality Engineering / Validation / Test Automation.
  • Hands-on experience testing ML models and/or LLM-based systems.
  • Solid understanding of model lifecycle (training validation deployment monitoring); bias, fairness, drift, overfitting, and calibration.
  • Experience with Python, notebooks, and ML testing frameworks.

AI / ML Knowledge

  • Familiarity with Supervised & unsupervised ML models
  • Model explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME, etc.)
  • Evaluation metrics for ML and GenAI systems
  • ML testing frameworks
  • Experience with model monitoring tools or custom pipelines

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Exposure to FHIR, EHR integrations, or healthcare data standards.
  • Familiarity with Model Risk Management (MRM) or AI governance frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP).

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead (Devices Tenant Migration)
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on shift technical authority for high volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Windows 10/11 device transition, Intune/Endpoint Manager re enrolment patterns and Autopilot/Entra join-state activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands on leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Autopilot registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Autopilot profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Autopilot where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provision coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Autopilot/Intune escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Must Have (or Equivalent Experience)

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Windows device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11 provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Windows Autopilot (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Microsoft Entra ID device identity/join states (Entra joined / hybrid joined / registered concepts) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post cutover issues.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD 102, MS 102, SC 300 or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
  • ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids heroics that compromise repeatability.
  • Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
  • Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad hoc fixes.
  • Confident challenging readiness gaps ( not ready to migrate ) using evidence and agreed criteria.
  • Builds trust quickly with cross functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
  • Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
  • Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
  • Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.
  • Quality: first time success rate and defect/rework rate (failed enrolments, repeat tickets).
  • MTTR: mean time to restore/resolve for migration blocking device issues.
  • Evidence capture completeness: percentage of migrations with full log/audit package attached.
  • SLA adherence: on time completion of scheduled waves and timely escalation of blockers.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

jobDescription:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Agile Project Manager - iTakeControl to join our global team. This role will be fully onsite at our Pune office. There may be flexibility to transition to a hybrid work model in the future, based on business requirements.


Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives. We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry. Our global team is composed of nearly 800 full-time employees whose commitment to creativity, quality, and on-time delivery is unrivaled in our space.


At Red Nucleus, we believe in providing a rich working environment that pushes us to innovate in ways that engages our employees to be their best selves. Our culture is about meaningful work, a true sense of community, and fun. We love to celebrate our people and we are proud to have been Internationally recognized as a Great Place to Work".


How You Will Contribute

In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.

Job Overview

iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in-house and building the team that will own and grow it.


We are looking for an experienced Agile Project Manager to own delivery and be the bridge between the business and the engineering team. You will balance two priorities: coordinating the delivery of the platform to clients including configuring and launching new clinical studies and driving the ongoing development of the product. The immediate focus is keeping client delivery running smoothly; as that settles into a steady cadence, the role grows to take on more of the process governance-Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement.


This is a delivery-accountable role for someone who can translate between business and technical teams, keep priorities clear, and make sure the right work ships at the right time. It works closely with US-based stakeholders and requires daily overlap with US hours.

What Youll Own

  • Client delivery own the end-to-end delivery and configuration of the platform for clients, getting new studies live and supported on time and within compliance
  • Product delivery own the teams delivery rhythm: prioritization, planning, and release coordination for the core platform in collaboration with the Product management team
  • The bridge intake the feature requirements, enhancement requests from product team and create the realistic development plan in collaboration with the engineering team, and keep both sides aligned on what comes first and why
  • Priority calls make and communicate the trade-offs when client delivery and product work compete for the same people
  • Delivery health track and report progress using meaningful flow metrics, and surface risks early with options
  • Process efficiency - As the engineering team matures, build efficiency KPIs for teams delivery and quality performance.

You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns coordination and delivery.


What Were Looking For

Experience and Mindset

  • 7+ years managing software delivery, with a strong track record of shipping on time
  • Proven experience owning client-facing delivery or implementation not only internal product work
  • Strong agile background, with the judgement to choose and adapt the right approach for the team rather than applying one framework by rote (we are not tied to a single methodology)
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent priorities and competing deadlines
  • A natural translator between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, who can negotiate realistic plans between the two
  • Strong ownership instincts accountable for outcomes, not just facilitation
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills builds trust quickly across clients, leadership, and the engineering team, and keeps everyone informed and aligned
  • Stays composed under pressure keeps a clear head and a steady hand when priorities collide, deadlines tighten, or issues escalate, and brings the team along calmly
  • Clear, honest communicator who brings problems forward early

Clinical and Regulatory

  • Life sciences background is essential experience delivering software in clinical trials, healthcare IT, pharma, medical devices, or an equivalent regulated environment
  • Understanding of what it means to deliver within a validated, GxP-compliant system change control, data integrity, and the discipline a regulated environment demands

Technical Fluency

  • Enough technical fluency to coordinate engineering work credibly understand dependencies, ask the right questions, and challenge estimates (you do not need to write code)
  • Comfortable with standard delivery and collaboration tooling, and open to AI-assisted tools that speed up planning and reporting

Education and Experience



  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • 7+ years in software project / delivery management, including client-facing delivery and/or Scrum Master roles
  • 3+ years leading delivery for an engineering team
  • 3+ years within regulated or validated software environments (clinical, GxP, FDA, HIPAA, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  • Agile and/or project management certification (CSM, PSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, PMP, or equivalent) a plus
  • Experience in enterprise Agile transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD processes.
  • Direct experience with a clinical trial / patient engagement / eCOA platform preferred


This job description captures the essential functions of this role as of July 2026. Management reserves the right to modify it as the platform and team evolve.

  • Comprehensive benefits and wellness programs focused on healthy lifestyles
  • Generous paid time off, employee assistance programs and flexible work arrangements
  • Performance driven environment including professional development and transfer opportunities

  • Celebrations! We love to celebrate service anniversaries, holidays, diversity and inclusion events, project milestones and anything else that is meaningful to our employees

jobDescription:
Job Opening for Senior Data Scientist

Reports to: Head of Data Science - Consulting

Team: Custom Consulting-Data Science

Level: Senior Consultant


Role Purpose

We are looking for Senior Data scientist to lead the technical automation edge of our Data Science team's work. This role is for someone as comfortable writing SQL/Python and building AI-driven workflows as they are interpreting consulting data someone who can turn repeatable research, data modelling tasks into reliable, scaled-up processes. The Data Science team works horizontally across GlobalData's consulting verticals Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail, Automotive, Agriculture and others — so automation built here is reused across bespoke, client-specific consulting engagements rather than one fixed sector. The team is actively building out a Projects & Skills-based automation pipeline (using tools like Claude) spanning proposal drafting, research instrument design, data consolidation, assisted modelling and report generation. A key focus area is automating secondary desk research — extracting insights from industry reports, online SKU analysis, company financial statements, and consumer survey creation/analysis.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build automation for the consulting workflow — SKU/store audits, secondary research consolidation, survey data processing, report and deck generation — using Python, SQL and AI-assisted tooling.
  • Build automation to extract and structure insights from secondary sources — industry reports, online SKU/pricing audits, and annual/quarterly company financial statements — to speed up model inputs across engagements.
  • Develop AI based tools to support consumer survey creation and scripting logic, and to automate first-pass analysis of survey outputs.
  • Extend the team's existing Claude-based automation initiative: build and maintain reusable Skills (repeatable SOPs) and Project knowledge bases across proposal, research, modelling and delivery stages.
  • Build and maintain SQL/Python pipelines that clean, validate and consolidate structured/unstructured research inputs ahead of modelling — reducing manual analyst effort.
  • Support market sizing, forecasting work with a strong analytics lens, including exploring transparent/interpretable forecasting approaches (e.g. driver-based or hierarchical models) as an alternative to black-box outputs.
  • Partner with consultants across verticals — Consumer, Food & Beverage, Packaging, Retail and others — on custom consulting solutions, bringing automation and analytics into bespoke, client-specific frameworks rather than standard reporting.
  • Manage and coach junior consultants and analysts on automation- and analytics-heavy workstreams.

Required Skills & Experience

You will work closely with the Solution Architect and delivery leadership on the wider architecture, and you will be the person who makes sure it actually lands in production the way it was designed.

You will also be hands-on in how we adopt AI/ML and LLM-based capabilities across our delivery portfolio.


Key Responsibilities


Technical Design & Delivery

  • Own the technical design of assigned modules and applications application logic, integration points, data model, and deployment approach.
  • Translate functional requirements and user stories into technical designs, sequence diagrams, API contracts, and data models.
  • Contribute to solution-level architecture decisions and document trade-offs for the options considered and rejected.
  • Break down features into tasks, estimate effort realistically, and drive them to completion within sprint commitments.
  • Design with non-functional requirements in mind from the start: performance, scalability, security, observability, and cost.
  • Execute staged modernisation of legacy applications (e.g., .NET Framework / .NET Core current LTS) under an agreed migration plan.
  • Apply and enforce engineering standards: coding guidelines, branching strategy, code review expectations, test coverage, and definition of done.

Hands-On Engineering

  • Write production code for the complex, high-risk, or performance-critical parts of the system.
  • Build proofs of concept, reference implementations, and reusable components for the team.
  • Review pull requests with substance correctness, security, performance, and readability, not just style.
  • Diagnose production issues: performance bottlenecks, memory pressure, N+1 queries, cache behaviour, and concurrency problems.
  • Keep CI/CD, automated testing, and quality gates working and taken seriously by the team.

Cloud & Platform

  • Build and operate solutions on Azure or AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, and secrets management.
  • Implement containerisation and deployment pipelines where appropriate (Docker, and Kubernetes/AKS/EKS where in use).
  • Instrument applications for observability logging, metrics, tracing, alerting and act on what they show.
  • Flag cost implications of design choices and implement agreed optimisations.

AI/ML & LLM Solutions

  • Build LLM-backed features: RAG pipelines, chunking and embedding strategy, vector store integration, retrieval quality, and prompt and context design.
  • Understand the practical trade-offs between prompt engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning, and pick sensibly for the problem at hand.
  • Handle the real constraints of LLM systems: latency, token cost, rate limits, caching, fallback behaviour, and graceful degradation.
  • Implement evaluation and guardrails groundedness checks, hallucination mitigation, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
  • Have an informed view on where AI/ML genuinely adds value and where it does not.
  • Work with data engineering on the pipelines and data quality these features depend on.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Lead a team of 38 engineers day to day: task allocation, standups, unblocking, and progress visibility.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
  • Own the technical quality of what your team ships, including defect triage and release readiness.
  • Support technical hiring interviewing and candidate evaluation.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, tech talks, and reusable IP.

Client & Delivery Support

  • Join technical discussions and requirement clarification sessions with clients where needed.
  • Provide effort estimates and technical inputs for proposals and solution approach documents.
  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to project managers, clients, and stakeholders.

Required Skills


Must Have Depth Expected

  • 69 years in software engineering, with production systems you have personally built and shipped.
  • Strong .NET / C# ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, async programming, dependency injection, and current LTS versions.
  • Solid working experience with one cloud platform Azure or AWS. Azure preferred (App Service, Functions, Azure SQL / PostgreSQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Entra ID, Application Insights). AWS equivalents equally acceptable.
  • At least one modern frontend framework in depth Angular or React plus TypeScript. Working familiarity with the other is a plus.
  • Node.js for services, tooling, or BFF layers.
  • Databases: strong SQL (SQL Server / PostgreSQL), data modelling, indexing, and query tuning. Awareness of NoSQL and when it fits.
  • Design and architectural patterns: REST API design, layered/clean architecture, messaging and queues, caching strategies, and a working understanding of microservices and event-driven design including when a monolith is the better answer.
  • Security fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, RBAC, secrets management, OWASP Top 10.
  • DevOps: Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git branching strategies, Docker.

Must Have Working Understanding

  • Practical understanding of AI/ML concepts and the ML lifecycle.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM-based application development RAG, embeddings, vector databases (pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or similar), and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with major model providers and the trade-offs between hosted APIs and self-hosted/open models.
  • Python for AI/ML, scripting, and data work.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform).

Non-Technical

  • Clear written communication your design notes and PR comments matter as much as your code.
  • Ability to explain a technical trade-off to a project manager and to a junior engineer, on the same day, without changing your answer.
  • Comfortable being challenged and equally comfortable changing your mind when the argument is better.
  • Ownership: you follow a decision through to production, not to the end of the design phase.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master's is a plus.
  • Equivalent demonstrable experience will be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Preferred (Added Advantage)

  • Cloud certification Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or the AWS equivalents.
  • Experience in an IT services or consulting environment with multiple concurrent clients.
  • Exposure to data engineering and analytics Azure Synapse, Databricks, PySpark, dbt, Power BI.
  • Experience running containerised workloads in production.
  • Experience shipping an AI/LLM feature to production, including how it was evaluated.
  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking.

What Success Looks Like in This Role


First 90 days

  • Productive in the codebase and reviewing pull requests independently.
  • Understood the module landscape you own and identified its top technical risks with evidence.
  • Delivered at least one design document and one feature shipped end to end.

First 6–12 months

  • Engineering standards consistently followed by your team, with review and test discipline visibly improved.
  • Measurable improvement in delivery predictability, defect escape rate, or system performance.
  • At least one AI/LLM capability built, evaluated, and delivered to production or a credible pilot.
  • One or more engineers visibly levelled up under your mentorship.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of the technical design and delivery of the systems you work on.
  • Direct access to leadership and a short path from decision to implementation.
  • Room to grow into a Solution Architect role, with the support to get there.
  • Hands-on work on modern cloud and AI engineering, not maintenance.
  • Sponsorship for certifications and continuous learning.
  • A collaborative, engineering-led environment.

How to Apply

Share your CV at [careers email] with the subject line "Application – Technical Lead – Pune". Include a brief note on one technical decision you made that turned out to be wrong, and what you did about it.
